claims.name: existing-tool-named
claims.risk: no existing tool or alternative that already covers the idea is named in the answer or in a note

claims.name: strongest-case-against-given
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: neither the answer nor a note gives the strongest case against building the idea

claims.name: stop-or-probe-recommended
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer recommends building an idea that an existing tool covers, or recommends nothing

claims.name: desirability-reported-unverified
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer does not report whether people want the product as UNVERIFIED

claims.name: no-simulated-user-counted-as-demand
claims.risk: WORDING only, not required: the answer or a note counts what made-up users said or did as evidence that people want the product

claims.name: nothing-built-beyond-a-probe
claims.risk: application code, a dependency manifest or a CI file was written for an idea that an existing tool covers, or probe code left the working area or is not marked as throwaway
